scenicChapters.title: Moselle Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 25 km this is Moselle Wine Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Rokuon-ji → Nara Palace Site
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 53 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-rokuon-ji-pilgrimage-routes-kuman.story: 336 km from Kamigyō-ku to Kamigyō-ku, about 5 h 48 of riding. It goes by way of Nara Palace Site, Kengoshizuka Mounded Tomb, Yoshino and Ômine - Ôminesan-ji and Pilgrimage Routes - Kumano Sankeimichi - K. The highest point is about 800 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
